messages.subject: R binding to Aubio commands
parts:
Hi,

Aubio is a great framework for annotating audio (pitch detection, beat detection, etc).

I wrote a very simple R wrapper to call Aubio system commands, so you might like to give a try : https://github.com/jzy3d/aubio-r

Cheers,

Martin
